name: Creation Genius – AI Content Generator & SEO Writer
author: Bhashkaranand Joshi

sections.description:
Struggling to Keep Your Blog Active?

We know the pain. You want to rank higher on Google and engage your audience, but researching, writing, and formatting high-quality articles takes hours. Most AI tools just give you raw text that you still have to copy, paste, format, and optimize manually.

Meet Your New AI Co-Pilot

Creation Genius is the only AI content engine that lives inside your WordPress dashboard. It doesn’t just write text; it understands your website. By analyzing your existing content, “About Us” pages, and writing style, it generates articles that fit your brand perfectly—complete with proper formatting, categories, and tags.

Fact-Accurate & Reliable Content

Unlike generic AI that can hallucinate, Creation Genius uses a specific fact-verification pipeline to ensure the information used in your articles is accurate, reliable, and up-to-date. We prioritize quality and truth, so you can publish with confidence.

Instant, Free, and Seamless

Forget complicated setups. Creation Genius offers instant onboarding. Just click “Connect” in the settings, and you’re ready to generate unlimited content for free (for a limited time). No credit cards, no manual API keys—just pure productivity.

Key Features

  • 🚀 Precision AI Controls: Easily set your tone, audience demographics, and even specific topics to include or exclude. This ensures your content is relevant, unique, and perfectly tailored to your readers.
  • 📂 Multifaceted Content Formats: Whether you need a deep-dive Article, a step-by-step How-to Guide, a high-converting Landing Page, or a comprehensive FAQ section, our engine handles it all in seconds.
  • 🧠 Site-Wide Context & Memory: The plugin learns from your site’s color scheme, formatting style, and founder details to create content that feels authentically yours.
  • 💡 Smart Topic Recommendations: Stuck for ideas? Our engine analyzes your niche and your site’s history to suggest winning topics likely to perform well.
  • ⚡ Native WordPress Integration: The AI automatically handles the boring stuff: assigning relevant WP Tags, selecting the correct WP Category, and writing an SEO-friendly Meta Description.
  • 🎯 SEO Optimized: Content is structured with proper H1-H6 tags and keyword placement to help you rank better from day one.

External Services

To function, this plugin connects to the Creation Genius Cloud Platform.

  • Service: Creation Genius API (https://creationgenius.com/)
  • Purpose: Processes your prompts and generates text content.
  • Data Shared:
    • Your prompt text (topics, keywords).
    • Site metadata (URL, language, active theme info) for context.
    • Plugin settings (tone, length preferences).
  • Privacy: We respect your data. Your content is yours. We do not use your generated content to train our public models.
  • Terms: Terms of Service
  • Policy: Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Download & Install:

    • Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
    • Search for “Creation Genius” or upload the plugin zip file.
    • Click Install Now and then Activate.

  2. Instant Connect:

    • Navigate to the Creation Genius > Settings menu.
    • Click the “Connect” button.
    • That’s it! Your site is now authenticated and ready to generate content.

  3. Start Creating:

    • Go to New Post, pick a topic or use a recommendation, and hit Generate.
sections.faq:
Is Creation Genius free?

Yes! We are currently in a completely free public beta. You can generate unlimited content to test the full power of our engine without any cost.

How is this better than using ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini directly?

Great question. While those tools are amazing, they are “general purpose” chat bots.
* WP Native: They don’t know your WordPress categories or tags. We automatically assign them.
* Context Aware: They don’t know your specific site history or “About Us” details unless you paste them in every time. We learn it once and apply it everywhere.
* Accuracy: We use a specialized pipeline to ensure information is fact-accurate and reliable for your niche.
* SEO: We automatically generate the Meta Description field and use SEO-friendly structures that bots can’t inject into your site.

Do I need to pay for an API Key?

No. Our onboarding is instant and free. You simply click “Connect” inside the plugin, and we handle the authentication securely in the background.

Does it work with page builders like Elementor or Divi?

Yes! Creation Genius generates standard WordPress posts and pages. Once the content is created, you can edit it with any page builder of your choice.

Is the content unique?

Absolutely. Our AI engine generates unique content for every request, even for the same topic. We recommend always reviewing and adding your personal touch before publishing.
